notes.title: DCR: Drive.Crash.Repeat Released
notes.content:
After a lot of work, this is to announce the release of DCR: Drive.Crash.Repeat; the world's hardest car game!

Enjoy it and be fair to the game and the huge effort that went into making it.

DCR: Drive.Crash.Repeat is a retro style, ludicrous auto-forward driving game with an amazing twist, and absolutely no brakes! Drive your way through tens of handcrafted levels (to the extent that each level has its own name), across different atmospheric worlds!

Cheers!

notes.title: Coming Soon Announcement
notes.content: DCR: Drive.Crash.Repeat, the hardest car game in the world, will be released very soon to PC and Mac. The store page is ready and fully loaded.
